It is a shell check rather than a committed pytest assertion, appropriate since this node changes guidance prose with no code path; nothing here would silently regress if the prose drifted back, short of re-running the same grep by hand.

No banned plan-stage or version labels in any touched path or symbol. The figure script is a plain matplotlib module under docs/figures/, consistent with the project's plotting convention.
